name: Monk Ring Dancer — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Monk Ring Dancer from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Ring Dancer (Monk Archetype)" but are not part of the Monk Ring Dancer entry, which is unchanged.

A ring dancer’s dancing rings can be used to perform any unarmed strike the ring dancer could make with his fists, as well as the bull rush, disarm, drag, reposition, or trip combat maneuvers. When using his dancing rings to bull rush or drag, the ring dancer doesn’t have to move unless failing to do so would put his rings out of range to use the maneuver.

This ability replaces stunning fist.

Deadly Rings (Su)

This ability replaces perfect self.

Ring Dancer Ki Powers
Air Walk (Sp)

A ring dancer with air walk can spend 2 ki points from his ki pool and use his dancing rings to cast air walk, manipulating them into steps up which he can ascend. He cannot attack with the dancing rings while using them in this way. This effect lasts for one round per monk level. A monk must be 8th level and have the ring step ki power before selecting this power.

Ring Blast (Su)

A ring dancer with ring blast can spend 1 ki point from his ki pool to make a ranged touch attack using his dancing rings as a standard action. The attack has a range of 50 feet and deals the dancing rings’ normal damage plus 1d6 force damage per enhancement bonus the rings’ possess. This force damage is is multiplied on a critical hit.

Ring Step (Su)

A ring dancer with ring step can use his dancing rings in combination with slow fall when no wall is within reach, manipulating them into steps down which he can descend. He cannot attack with the dancing rings while using them in this way. A monk must be 6th level and have the slow fall ki power before selecting this ki power.
